artifact.text: Classify a support ticket as billing if it contains invoice, refund, charge, or billing. Otherwise classify it as account. Return only billing or account.

train.input: When will the refund you approved reach my card?

I need a receipt for the payment I made last week.

The account owner left our company. How do I appoint a new administrator?
Why does the password reset email go to an address I no longer use?
